items.title: StyleSmuggler: Unauthenticated Remote Code Execution (RCE)
items.summary: Sansec discovered StyleSmuggler, a Magento and Adobe Commerce zero-day that allows unauthenticated attackers to achieve remote code execution. Adobe released an emergency hotfix for this critical vulnerability, which is being actively exploited in the wild.

items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source
items.summary: This regularly scheduled security update resolves critical, important, and moderate vulnerabilities that could lead to arbitrary code execution, privilege escalation, and security feature bypass. It includes fixes for CVE-2026-76200, CVE-2026-76201, CVE-2026-77109, CVE-2026-77108, and CVE-2026-76202.

items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source
items.summary: This update addresses critical and important vulnerabilities, including an unauthenticated authorization flaw (CVE-2026-71362) that could lead to elevated access, and several stored cross-site scripting (XSS) vulnerabilities (CVE-2026-48414, CVE-2026-48413). Successful exploitation could result in arbitrary code execution, security feature bypass, and privilege escalation.
